b3_defects.description: In the third screenshot (debug view), a large section of the desk surface is floating in mid-air with no support legs underneath or connecting it to any base unit.

In Image 2, chair_01 has a plant pot sitting directly on its seat cushion, which suggests an incorrect placement relative to the intended use of furniture as seating surfaces for people rather than tables.

worst_object.reason: In screenshot 3 (and faintly in others), a large floating segment of desk surface is visible with no structural connection or legs, creating a major scaling and assembly error.

comment: The scene's lighting and general atmosphere are consistent and immersive, avoiding the typical issues of whiteouts. However, serious geometric errors regarding floating components in the furniture models (specifically the desk) significantly detract from realism.
